disagreements.issue: SCI_AMB_001_POSTERIOR_MEASURE, SCI_AMB_002_SEED_FINGERPRINT, SCI_AMB_005_S_CERTIFICATE_DERIVATION, and SCI_AMB_006_ACCEPTANCE_EVENT ask whether the asserted factorized posterior and exact S symmetry apply to the literal uniform 128-q deterministic generator after conditioning on all q-derived public bytes.

positions.position: Treat the registered 128 seeds as realizing the declared full-product measure, regard A=1 as constant, and require RANDOM-S decisive value 1/4, zero conditional mutual information, and the <=.35 leakage ceilings.

A 128-point deterministic SHA-derived population is not an exactly factorized probability space; public 96-bit handles and other legal bytes can fingerprint q and thereby reveal q-linked hidden variables. Domain separation supplies computational separation, not exact statistical independence.

resolution.rationale: The critic's position is selected. The RANDOM/MOTIF causal coupling and the analytic four-way S symmetry are valuable and must survive, but the current exact bytes do not justify transferring that symmetry to the literal finite generator. This is a specification defect requiring rework, not a mechanically valid scientific rejection and not something post-implementation tests can repair retroactively.
resolution.selected_position: Require a successor exact contract whose literal sampling measure is explicitly factorized and exactly balanced with public nuisance bytes ancillary to hidden structure, or whose exact quotient is formally proved Bayes-equivalent to the literal generator after conditioning on every legal public byte. The successor must define A=1 over the same measure and include a generator-aware 128-seed fingerprint adversary.
resolution.required_change: Before any CPU implementation authority, bind the complete latent probability space, prior weights, conditioning variables, acceptance event, ancillary/public-byte construction, and proof of the MOTIF point mass, RANDOM 1/4 posterior, and zero conditional mutual information. Add a mandatory seed-enumeration leakage test over each complete legal joint view; no cryptographic opacity assumption may substitute for exact independence.

resolution.rationale: The critic's position is selected. Exact replay is not exact specification when implementers still choose the byte-generating registry after authorization. Target association fields are especially consequential because they can reveal q, family, pairing, or matching metadata.

Designer-supplied oracle codes are descriptive generator/codec diagnostics, not learned compression.
CPU eligibility does not answer the representation, weights, development, transport, or flywheel questions required for paper relevance.

Retain the relative trusted-base denial test and construe forbidden future organs as absent capabilities, including dormant modules, schemas, dependencies, options, plugins, hooks, and report-to-input paths. It does not cure the measure defect.

Retain no-rejection, complete-deck, exact-budget, shortest-plan, and per-target gates after exact target bytes and the repaired measure are bound. Report A3 only as dual-plan conjunctive retention; the current test cannot establish connected composition.

Retain as the decisive successor CPU test, but the current expected values are not justified until the literal measure, priors, controller bytes, ancillary public fields, immutable projections, noninterference, arbitrary joint-view recomputation, and seed-enumeration adversary are normatively bound.

Retain only if the successor keeps codec/report scope and binds every grammar, decoder, deck, interface, resource, and report byte; otherwise a successor must remove and re-register the dependent scope rather than this consensus inventing a replacement. Any retained output is descriptive oracle codec/storage load, never development or learned compression.

Retain run-versus-skip continuation equality, canaries, target destruction, and report isolation under exactly one successor suffix domain. Mutable persistent controller fixtures are excluded and immutable fixtures appear only through bound hashes.

Retain fail-closed verdict precedence and transition denial. Extend successor claim-linter fixtures to preserve the exact limitations: CPU load is not development, A3 is not connected composition, twins prove only authentic-content dependence, oracle MDL is not learned compression, and CPU RETAIN is C01 only.
